rule.anchor: point-to-segment; own wire = the parent layout:wire:*; all other wires are foreign
rule.ink: rectangle-to-segment; if the ink x-range does not intersect the own wire x-range, ink is N/A and only the anchor test applies
rule.strict: anchor and ink must both be strictly nearer to the own wire than to every foreign wire; a tie is not nearest
rule.bound: the existing d(anchor, own) <= 6 is retained
rule.margin: hard fail only when a foreign wire is more than 1.0 unit closer; [0,1.0] including a tie is warn, not pass and not hard fail

surface: 55 visible Name labels whose parent is a wire; flag-parent labels are a separate surface and are not counted in the 55

sourceSnapshot.note: Offline snapshot only: t31 has 21 components and 55 wires/55 pairs, but its comps carry no ComponentType and its pages array has 18 records, so it cannot reproduce t53's 8 part / 13 netflag / 2 pages. t53 itself is exit 2 (bridge unreachable); this snapshot is not a substitute for the live invariant gate.

thresholdDecision.notASafetyMargin: MCU-33 is exactly 1.00 in the r6t2 four-sample set; a 0.02 unit box movement flips it to hard fail. 1.0 is a boundary, never a safe margin.
thresholdDecision.reject0_8: 0.8 converts the six exact-1.00 normal-label warnings into hard fail: false positives on known-normal bus-adjacent labels; stricter is not safer here.
thresholdDecision.reject1_2: 1.2 turns a real 1.1 inversion into a warning; it softens the gate and needs a larger sample, not a flip-count argument.
thresholdDecision.notLowered: 未采纳任何调低（not adopted）：0.8 会把已知正常的 1.00 警告变成 hard fail，1.2 会把真实 1.1 反转软化成 warning；2/4 四样本的 MCU-25/27 记为 warn 而非 fail，1.0 保持不变。
